Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/sarah-louisa-forten-purvis/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Sarah Louisa Forten Purvis, the author, died 1884 (Wikidata Q61834412). The facts file gives two dates, 1884-10-29 and 1883 (no day or month); both are before 1925.

First publication of the text used: 1831 to 1836 (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poems published between 1831 and 1836 by Sarah Louisa Forten Purvis')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the poems were first published between 1831 and 1836, before 1931, so the text is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin (not needed for this decision): every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (see the list above), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
